method.agreement_conditioned_miss_counts: either miss means at least one of the two order estimates is >20% from truth; both miss means each is >20% from truth. These counts are among pairs passing the agreement factor.
method.agreement_definition: max(first, second) / min(first, second) <= factor threshold
method.matched_cohort: Pair first and second estimates only within the same saved sample scenario and zero-based realization index. Each spacing/condition group contains three barrier scenarios with twelve paired realizations each.
method.qualification: A first/second pair is eligible only when both saved profile_shapes point estimates are finite, positive, and not flagged hit_barrier_bound. There is no additional fit-success field in the sealed output. Barrier intervals are reported but do not qualify or reject a point estimate.
method.sensitivity_limits: Counts describe this finite synthetic design and its saved nuisance realizations, not a probability for experimental scans or a calibrated real-data uncertainty.

scope: Read-only reanalysis of the frozen known-barrier recovery fits. No images were regenerated, no profiles were refit, no truth values were inferred, and no interpolation or extrapolation was used.
